name: @graphviz-pure/wasm
description: A pure-Rust port of Graphviz 16.1.0 (all eight layout engines), compiled to WebAssembly, with the same output in browsers, Node.js, Deno, Bun and Workers. Not affiliated with the Graphviz project.

scripts.build:wasm: cd .. && CARGO_TARGET_WASM32_UNKNOWN_UNKNOWN_RUSTFLAGS='-C opt-level=z' CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO=fat cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p graphviz-pure-wasm && wasm-bindgen --target web --remove-name-section --remove-producers-section --out-dir web/pkg target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/graphviz_pure_wasm.wasm && node scripts/export-graphviz-error.mjs web/pkg/graphviz_pure_wasm.js && cp web/graphviz_pure_wasm.d.ts web/pkg/graphviz_pure_wasm.d.ts && if command -v wasm-opt >/dev/null; then wasm-opt -Oz --enable-bulk-memory --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int --enable-sign-ext --enable-mutable-globals web/pkg/graphviz_pure_wasm_bg.wasm -o web/pkg/graphviz_pure_wasm_bg.wasm; fi
